/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using untrusted input in file paths can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal-jsonschema
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["join", "abspath", "relpath"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential path traversal via file operation"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal via file operations - untrusted input used in file paths

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
 * @description Making HTTP requests with user-controlled URLs can lead to SSRF
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf-jsonschema
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request", "head", "patch"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("httplib").getMember("HTTPConnection").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("http").getMember("client").getMember("HTTPConnection").getACall()
  )
select call, "HTTP request that may be vulnerable to SSRF if URL is user-controlled"
findings.hypothesis: Check for HTTP requests that could be exploited for SSRF if URLs are user-controlled
